saints.name: St. Hyacinth
saints.title: Priest and Missionary
saints.shortBlurb: A Dominican friar called the Apostle of the North for his missions across Poland and the Slavic lands…
biography: Hyacinth (Jacek Odrowąż) was born in Silesia about 1185 and, according to tradition, received the Dominican habit in Rome from St. Dominic himself. Returning north, he planted the Order of Preachers in Poland and became its great missionary.

His tireless journeys carried the Gospel and the Dominican life through Poland, Prussia, Pomerania, and as far as Kiev among the peoples of Rus', earning him the name Apostle of the North. He died at Kraków in 1257 and was canonized in 1594.
saints.knownFor: Spreading the Dominican Order through the Slavic north.
